comparison.objective: Place a phone, watch, and earbuds case on their respective positions of a three-device charger.
comparison.physical_skill: Orient and seat three consumer devices so magnetic or contact charging engages.
comparison.success_condition: All three devices remain released and simultaneously indicate charging.
comparison.reason: Charging placement tests discrete docking and state activation, not parallel rail–jig mating or containment during block transfer. No missing rubric detail prevents distinction.
